"agent_done" typically means the agent called rlm.finish() or rlm.give_up() voluntarily. If the agent was cut off by budget, it would be "max_turns" or "max_tokens".

But the agent didn't call give_up (no GIVE_UP in final message) and the final message is empty... Maybe the agent just stopped and the system classified it as agent_done because it reached some terminal state.

Hmm, the final message is literally empty, which is unusual for a proper finish. This suggests the agent might have had its message truncated or it ended abnormally.

Let me just go with budget since the agent clearly was still in exploration phase (searching for functions) when it ended. It made 0 edits.

There are no separate "turn" entries visible - the turns count of 22 likely includes internal reasoning cycles plus tool calls. With only 9 tool calls and 22 turns, the agent spent 13 turns just thinking/reasoning.

I'll go with budget as the most likely cause.
